content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Telecom operator billing and network software and outsourced IT services; no mobile advertising or app distribution overlap."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Billing, customer care and payment software for pay-TV and telecom operators; different product and customer base."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Developer cloud infrastructure and hosting; shares developer customers but not advertising or app monetization."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Ad verification and measurement for brands; adjacent to advertising but does not sell ad inventory, monetization or app distribution."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Consumer dating social app earning subscriptions and in-app ads; a consumer app business, not an ad-tech or distribution platform."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Owns consumer lifestyle publishing brands and sells their audiences; content media rather than ad-tech or app monetization."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Advertising agency holding company selling creative and media buying services; a services business without a monetization platform."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise application development, data and infrastructure software; no advertising, app monetization or preload overlap."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise social media and customer experience software for large brands; different customers and product."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Marketing and advertising agency services with some marketing technology; agency model differs from ad-tech platforms."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Two-sided ad-tech platform selling native ad placements with publisher revenue sharing; similar monetization model, though no preload distribution."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Owns consumer media brands plus security and speed-test software; diversified and media-led, not an ad-tech platform."}]}
